HUGO CAvery, chief of the third race of the kings
of France, being count of Parra and Orleans; he was
refiled to the chrome for his military vollor and public
resturs in 287. See Fears, n 38.

parsed.faithful: HUGO Capet, chief of the third race of the kings of France, being count of Paris and Orleans; he was raised to the throne for his military valour and public virtues in 987. See France, n 38.
